category_overrides.label: Legal fees (any amount): Legal Operations reviews first
IT hardware over $5k: IT Procurement and Fixed Asset Accounting

approval_matrix.separation_of_duties: Requester can never approve their own spend; route to the next eligible approver up the chain.

capitalisation.tax_treatment: Non-recoverable sales tax and freight are capitalised with the asset.
capitalisation.owner: Fixed Asset Accounting decides capitalisation; the agent only routes.

po_policy.exempt_label: Utilities, telecoms, legal, insurance, memberships and subscription renewals under contract

prepaid.label: Service periods over one month and $10k+ are prepaid and amortised straight-line monthly.

risk.standing_receipt_rule: Recurring service categories billed monthly, within 10% of the 6-month average: the approver's approval doubles as receipt confirmation.

cutoff.label: Services consumed in a closed period should have been accrued. Unaccrued amounts of $25k or more are reported to Record-to-Report as out-of-period expense.

tax.label: When a seller does not charge sales tax on taxable goods shipped to Missouri, the buyer accrues use tax.

receipt.label: Receipt is evidenced by an existing record where one exists; otherwise the requester confirms. Reminder after 3 business days, escalation to the cost-centre owner after 5, supplier asked for a named contact after 8.

payment.label: Early-payment discounts are captured when the discount date has not passed; held invoices are excluded from every payment run.

routing.label: Intercompany recharges and employee reimbursements are not non-PO invoices and leave this queue.

price.label: Billed hourly rates must not exceed the engagement-letter rate for the role; matters over 90% of budget are flagged to the requesting lawyer.
